seed.name: Gaucher disease due to saposin C deficiency

partners.mechanism_chain: PSAP (HGNC:9110) —DISRUPTS→ Saposin C-mediated lysosomal lipid hydrolysis (GO:0005769); Saposin C-mediated lysosomal lipid hydrolysis (GO:0005769) —DECREASES→ Accumulated undegraded lipids (CHEBI:17577); Accumulated undegraded lipids (CHEBI:17577) —LEADS_TO→ Lysosomal storage (HP:0001251); ITGA2B (HGNC:6036) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet aggregation via integrin alpha-IIb beta-3 (GO:0007540); Platelet aggregation via integrin alpha-IIb beta-3 (GO:0007540) —DECREASES→ Bleeding tendency (HP:0011411); Platelet aggregation via integrin alpha-IIb beta-3 (GO:0007540) —DECREASES→ Thrombocytopenia (HP:0001873). Mutations in PSAP lead to impaired lysosomal lipid hydrolysis and accumulation of undegraded lipids, causing Gaucher disease features. Mutations in ITGA2B impair platelet aggregation, leading to bleeding disorders. While not directly linked by a single molecule, both diseases represent dysfunctions in distinct but critical cellular modules (lysosomal degradation and platelet function) which can result in overlapping systemic issues such as organomegaly or bleeding tendencies.

raw.translational: Understanding the distinct yet fundamental cellular processes disrupted in these diseases can inform therapeutic strategies. For Gaucher disease, enzyme replacement therapy and substrate reduction therapy are established. For Glanzmann's thrombasthenia, treatments focus on managing bleeding and platelet transfusions, and gene therapy is an area of research. Identifying shared pathways or molecular interactions could reveal novel therapeutic targets.

partners.mechanism_chain: PSAP (HGNC:9520) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal degradation (GO:0005774); Lysosomal degradation (GO:0005774) —DECREASES→ Glycosphingolipids (CHEBI:17791); Glycosphingolipids (CHEBI:17791) —LEADS_TO→ Gaucher disease symptoms (MONDO:0012517); APOA1 (HGNC:707) —DISRUPTS→ Reverse cholesterol transport (REACT:R-HSA-191774); Reverse cholesterol transport (REACT:R-HSA-191774) —DECREASES→ HDL particles (CHEBI:57437); HDL particles (CHEBI:57437) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoalphalipoproteinemia (MONDO:0032766). Loss-of-function mutations in PSAP impair lysosomal degradation, leading to the accumulation of glycosphingolipids and Gaucher disease symptoms. The convergence lies in the fundamental cellular processes of degradation and lipid metabolism, both essential for maintaining cellular homeostasis.
